null.method: circular rotation of every return array against a fixed calendar (inside each instrument's live span); the whole family re-scored per replicate; statistic studentised per formula to strip deterministic cost drift; max|z| across the family recorded
null.note: analytic sqrt(2 ln N) assumes N INDEPENDENT tries; these formulas are heavily correlated, so the empirical number is the one that governs

controls.purpose: the only formula that cleared the family bar is a month-end cross-asset reversal trade; these controls ask whether the CALENDAR is doing any work

placebo_window_sweep.description: identical SPY/TLT reversal signal, moved to other 2-session windows counted back from month end (rtdom). design / holdout Sharpe.

always_on_control.description: the same signal held EVERY session with no calendar gate at all
always_on_control.reading: held out, the ungated version earns 0.355 and the month-end-gated version 0.519. The calendar gate adds ~0.16 Sharpe out of sample -- inside the sampling error of a 9.6-year window. The calendar is not the edge.

verdict: THEME IS NOISE. 52 formulas; expected max |z| under the rotated null is 2.454 (p95 3.268). The best design result is z=+3.39 -- a ~4% event given 52 correlated tries, i.e. exactly what the luckiest formula in a family this size looks like when nothing is there. It halved out of sample (0.717 -> 0.412), and a control shows the ungated version of the same signal earns nearly as much held out, so the calendar gate itself is not carrying the return. Nothing here is promotable.
data_caveats: the 94-name single-stock panel (t9 cache) is names that existed in 2016 AND still have data in 2026: survivorship-biased and small/mid-cap tilted. Every XS_* row is the weakest evidence in the sweep and none of them survived anyway.
ETF daily bars are Yahoo adjusted closes -- total-return correct, but price LEVELS are retroactive. No formula here filters on a price level.

XT_FUNDING_PRE exits at the top of the settlement hour; a fill exactly at settlement would owe/collect funding, which this does not model. Both funding formulas lose money by 4 Sharpe on cost drift alone, so the caveat does not change the verdict.

crypto perp design window (2020-07..2023-12) contains one full bull-bear cycle only; long-only crypto formulas are mostly measuring beta, which is why XT_WEEKEND_ALTS shows a high raw Sharpe (1.33) but only z=+2.06 against its own rotated null.
